messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: ALERT: unusual auth traffic detected from multiple IPs. rule=waf-suspicious-auth; sample=200->401->200 patterns. Auto-created incident INC-3467.
sec-oncall-bot: paging sec oncall @maria and infra oncall @jun.
maria: ack - joining. who has the scope?
kevin: quick query shows a batch of debug logs forwarded to external s3 bucket path: s3://prod-logs/debug/edge-2026-03-20/requests.log.gz. snippets include Authorization headers. Example (redacted):
```
GET /v1/generate 200 "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGci..."
```
sophie: that looks like full bearer tokens leaked in logs. we should assume token compromise until proven otherwise.
jun: taking immediate edge actions: blocking offending CIDR 34.120.12.0/24 at edge and pausing log-forwarder to external buckets. running block now.
kevin: initiating key sweep for affected services: svc-inference, svc-logs, and api-gateway. updating KMS rotation policy.
maria: escalate to legal/compliance — potential PHI exposure. marking P0. @sophie please open SOC ticket and place hold on that S3 path.
sophie: SOC-1122 created. set S3 retention hold and moved snapshot to quarantine bucket: s3://prod-logs/quarantine/snapshot-3467890123.tar.gz. Steps: 1) rotate keys, 2) revoke sessions issued in window, 3) scrub leaked tokens from logs, 4) draft customer notice.
sec-oncall-bot: action items updated: [rotate-keys, revoke-sessions, scrub-logs, cust-notice]. ETA 45m.
kevin: revocation executed for tokens issued 2026-03-20T14:20Z-14:35Z. Auth service reports revoked=true for affected tokens, active session count=0 for those tokens.
jun: edge blocks applied, log-forwarder stopped, snapshot verified. preserving chain-of-custody metadata.
maria: CS/legal to prepare impacted tenant list (query by tenant_id in leaked log entries). @carla can you assist with customer triage?
carla: yep pulling tenant list now, will DM CS leads. so far looks like 3 tenants referenced, no high-volume exfil evidence yet.
kevin: initial impact estimate: 3 tenants possibly exposed. no evidence of outbound access beyond log writes. still treat as potential credential exposure.
sophie: scrub plan: replace Authorization values with "<REDACTED>" in any retained logs, keep locked forensic copy for investigators. automate with safe-scrub job.
maria: legal requests pause on external comms until we confirm rotations + customer list. update expected in ~30m.
kevin: monitoring rule adjusted to reduce noisy duplicates; alerting on new 401->200 patterns retained.
jun: handing off live mitigation to night oncall: maria -> alex. notes: verify key rotations, confirm revocations, finish scrub, prepare customer notification template.
maria: handing to @alex. I'll remain reachable for handoff questions.
alex: ack taking over. will validate rotation logs and coordinate with CS/legal for customer outreach.
pagerbot: Incident INC-3467 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Will auto-close when final customer outreach completed. :white_check_mark:
